name: Souls in the Balance
source:
Welcome to the crossroads of eternity, where your role is to balance the scales as the arbiter of souls brought to you by Charon, the timeless boatman, each soul carries its own story, its deeds, and awaits its final judgment. 

Dive into their life tales, unearth their actions, and wield your discernment to decide their eternal fate. Will you guide them to tranquility or condemn them to torment? Your investigations will unravel the intricate web that ties these souls together. Your decisions will shape not only their afterlife but also unveil the complex relationships and mysteries left behind in their wake.

It's more than a job, it's maintaining the equilibrium of eternity, in your hands. Welcome to 'Souls in the Balance', where every decision has an eternal echo.

[from [url=https://mixtoko.itch.io/souls-in-the-balance]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
欢迎来到永恒的十字路口，在这里，你的角色是作为永恒船夫卡戎带给你的灵魂仲裁者，平衡天平，每个灵魂都承载着自己的故事、自己的事迹，等待着它的最终审判。

深入研究他们的人生故事，挖掘他们的行为，并运用你的洞察力来决定他们永恒的命运。你会引导他们走向平静还是让他们遭受折磨？你的调查将揭开将这些灵魂联系在一起的错综复杂的网络。你的决定不仅会影响他们的来世，还会揭开他们身后留下的复杂关系和谜团。

这不仅仅是一份工作，它是在你手中维持永恒的平衡。欢迎来到“平衡中的灵魂”，这里的每一个决定都会产生永恒的回响。

[来自[url=https://mixtoko.itch.io/souls-in-the-balance]itch.io[/url]]
